description: pay-to-reach postage verification (SPEC §6.3) — the two load-bearing offline checks plus the anti-replay branch. (a) SETTLEMENT: payment_hash = SHA-256(preimage_bytes). (b) BINDING: the invoice description-hash = SHA-256(utf8(metadata) || utf8(payerdata)) — the recipient re-derives this ITSELF over verbatim bytes (LUD-18; wallets no longer enforce it, lnurl PR #234) and matches it against the bolt11 'h' tag, committing recipient + amount + nonce. (c) ANTI-REPLAY: a second message presenting the same payment_hash is rejected to the Requests tray by the recipient's local spent-ledger.
notes: payment_hash = SHA-256 of the 32 RAW preimage bytes (hex-decoded), not the hex string. description_hash = SHA-256 of utf8(metadata) concatenated with utf8(payerdata), both VERBATIM (never JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(x)) — reordering breaks the match). The recipient's bolt11 'h' tag must equal description_hash; the metadata's text/identifier must equal the claimed recipient. first_delivery accepts (records payment_hash in the spent-ledger); a replay of the same payment_hash to the same recipient is held in the Requests tray.
